comments.author: Nekos
comments.body:
Weather Phenomenon : Brocken Spectre - Recognition 10
Weather Phenomenon : Red Snow - Recognition 8
Both appear at the same spot-

A message will tell you theres's a phenomenon on the south-west.
It appear at the left path at the middle of the slope.

Brocken Spectre appears in the morning.
Red snow appears in the morning.

comments.author: ZarethKnyg
comments.body:
R10 collection: White Ore, Black Ore, Red Ore, Blue ore, Yellow ore, Green Ore, Iron Ore, Boulder, Rocks

R6 Procurement: Rocks

R14 search: Traveler's Notes, Quadrant, Rocks (stopped after about 10 minutes).

Pet find: Spicy Sauce, Assorted Ointments (rank 5), Peeled Seeds

Used the stacked boulder to the left (near the Brocken Spectre discovery).

Also found Ground Blizzard weather phenomenon on the other pathway from the stacked boulders that I used for collection/procurement.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This area is accessed by landing at the Bay of Bengal North Coast and going further inland - it's possible to do this despite a lack of a discovery (unlike older inland zones) so you can visit here as early as you like to. You will find the following items/goods/enemies:

Trade goods (Procurement):
None

Trade goods (Collection):
Boulders (R5)
Blue Ore (R2)
Stone (R5)
Green Ore (R2)
Red Ore (R2)
White Ore (R2)
Black Ore (R2)
Iron Ore (R5)
Yellow Ore (R2)

Trade goods (any skill/rank; junk-type)
Rocks

Items (Search):
Cold Resistant Fur Hat (R11)
Traveller's notes
Wood Spear
Adventurer's notes
Investigator's monocle
Telescope
Quadrant
Rusty short sword
Dull cutlass
Dull scimitar

NPCs:
Carrasco Gang Lv42 | drops Ointments
Carrasco Gang Lv44 | drops Eagle's Wings
Carrasco Lv45 | drops Bank and Cold Resistant Fur Clothes

Cheers.

NPC source: www.ssjoy.org/dho/field/1519306
